glossary.definition: (A) "Adjusted RBC report" means an RBC report that has been adjusted by the superintendent of insurance in accordance with division (C) of section 1753.32 of the Revised Code.

glossary.definition: (B) "Authorized control level RBC" means the number determined under the risk-based capital formula in accordance with the RBC instructions.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1753.31 to 1753.43 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 1753.31 - Risk-based capital for insurers model act definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Company action level RBC" means the product of 2.0 and a health insuring corporation's authorized control level RBC.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1753.31 to 1753.43 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 1753.31 - Risk-based capital for insurers model act definitions.

glossary.source_title: Section 1753.31 - Risk-based capital for insurers model act definitions.

glossary.source_title: Section 1753.31 - Risk-based capital for insurers model act definitions.

glossary.source_title: Section 1753.31 - Risk-based capital for insurers model act definitions.
